_comment: ADR 0060 decision 5. Baseline = the gzip size of every <script src> of an empty Next route, measured at Stage 0. Allowance = what a public page may add. Change these only with the owner's approval.

routeJs._comment: Job CF: the gzip JavaScript every page route loads on a first visit (scripts/audit-route-js.mjs, from the build alone; `npm run audit:route-js`, run by CI after the build). Measured 12 Oct 2026 in a production build: the public pages 146 to 150 KB (React and the Next.js client are about 112 KB of it), the signed-in pages 172 to 197 KB. Each number is the measured size plus about 2%: a route that grows past it fails. `routes` names the pages people open most and the few that are larger than the rest; `public` and `app` are the ceilings of every other page. Job CJ: the Office is a plain plush room (no three.js: its 3D chunk and its own office3d ceiling are gone), and Agent OWL and the Office owls (the plush owlets, jobs CI and CJ) are in the page itself; their pictures are lazy files, not script. Measured 13 Oct 2026 after job CJ: Today 200,190, the Office 182,479, the landing page 152,718 (margin 282). Raise a number only with a reason in the commit; the owner approves a raised ceiling. Owner decision 14 Oct 2026 (job CL, after CK): Today 201,000 -> 204,000 and the landing page 153,000 -> 156,000, headroom for waves 2 and 3 while the pack-aware frame (menu words, module gate, core tab) landed; a later trim job takes the weight out again. Job CO (night run C2, 15 Oct 2026): the four new building-materials product routes (/materials, /materials/new, /materials/[itemId], /materials/[itemId]/edit) carry the product editor (photos, extra details) and measure 187,805 B, about 1.8 KB over the signed-in default; they are new routes of a new feature, not a raise of an existing ceiling, and the saree catalogue routes stay under their own (the materials screens are on their own routes so that a saree workspace never downloads them). Each is set to 190,000. A trim job can share the photo code of the two editors. Job CQ (night run C2, 15 Oct 2026): the five new campaign routes (/campaigns, /campaigns/new, /campaigns/[campaignId], /campaigns/[campaignId]/edit, /call-list) share one client chunk set of 187,196 B (the form, the people list with its list reader, the approval sheet, the results and the call list), about 1.2 KB over the signed-in default; they are new routes of a new feature, not a raise of an existing ceiling. Each is set to 190,000.
